clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Shari Stilwell trains Forsaken in the paladin's path. She is stationed in Tirisfal Glades, where the undead who endure the Light's pain learn holy and martial discipline.

In Brill, Shari Stilwell guides Forsaken who seek the path of holy warriors. The Light brings the undead excruciating pain, yet she trains those willing to endure it. She helps newcomers find their footing in Tirisfal Glades, through early training and the adjustments of Forsaken life. Those she guides seek a place within the Forsaken kingdom.

Shari bears the same family name as Daphne, Merissa, and Jordan Stilwell, a renowned smith among the living in the southern kingdoms. Whether the fall of Lordaeron tore Shari from these kin, or whether their bond is only distant, remains unknown amid the Scourge's devastation.
